items.title: 不确定性触发
items.hypothesis: Only review uncertain or high-score clips to cut VLM cost while preserving F1 under a fixed budget.
items.implementation: Compute s,u from fast_score; should_review=(s>=0.65)|(u>=0.2); slow path only when true. Executable params in config.trigger.
items.ablation: trigger on/off: baseline vs trigger rows in ablation.csv
items.acceptanceCriteria: simulated VLM call rate < 20%; F1 not below FastSlow-I1 when memory/VLM added
items.comparisonDesign: Compare Lightweight, FastSlow-I1, VLM-all on same camera-demo clips and seeds policy

items.title: 场景正常记忆
items.hypothesis: Retrieving top-k normal scene memories improves hard-clip discrimination and can reduce redundant VLM calls.
items.implementation: Build memory from train-normal only; retrieve topK=5; produce s_mem. excludeTestLabels=true.
items.acceptanceCriteria: no test-label leakage into memory bank; AUROC of trigger-memory >= trigger
items.comparisonDesign: Identical trigger thresholds; toggle memory retrieval only

items.title: 证据化 VLM 复核
items.hypothesis: Structured VLM evidence improves trust and calibrated fusion versus score-only slow path.
items.implementation: Simulated VLM returns JSON {score, rationale, evidence_spans}; fuse with weights fast/memory/vlm.
items.baseline: score-only slow path without structured evidence (trigger-memory)
items.ablation: VLM evidence on/off: trigger-memory vs full
items.acceptanceCriteria: every reviewed clip yields parseable JSON evidence fields; full AUROC >= trigger-memory
items.comparisonDesign: Same memory bank; enable/disable VLM JSON evidence and fusion

items.title: 融合分数校准
items.hypothesis: Temperature scaling on fused scores improves calibration (ECE) without hurting AUROC.
items.implementation: Fit temperature T on val logits; apply s'=sigmoid(logit(s)/T) before thresholding.
items.acceptanceCriteria: ECE decreases on val; AUROC change within ±0.5 pp (when implemented)

items.title: 记忆污染过滤
items.hypothesis: Rejecting anomalous or low-confidence inserts prevents memory bank pollution.
items.implementation: Gate memory writes with fast_score < 0.3 and uniqueness check before insert.
items.acceptanceCriteria: injected anomaly clips are not retained; AUROC does not drop vs filtered bank

items.title: 时间一致性约束
items.hypothesis: Temporal smoothing reduces flicker false positives on adjacent clips.
items.implementation: HMM or moving-average over clip scores with window W=3.
items.acceptanceCriteria: false positive rate on contiguous normal segments decreases; latency overhead < 5 ms

items.title: 跨场景适配
items.hypothesis: Lightweight scene adapters reduce drift when camera location changes.
items.implementation: Per-scene affine adapter on fast features; optional memory rebuild per scene.
items.acceptanceCriteria: cross-scene AUROC gap narrows; not claimed in this simulated demo
